hypothesis: The previous measurements show only zero or one allocated block and no full-block caching or prefix reuse. Initial-allocation overhead is therefore the main cost driver; token counts should expose enough distinct entry states to evaluate residual variation within the two observed paths.

pcvs.name: initial_allocation
pcvs.rationale: Captures the observed cost difference between initial allocation and incremental decoding.

pcvs.name: new_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes prompt sizes and measures any token-dependent work during allocation.

pcvs.name: computed_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes decoding positions and captures work depending on the existing computed prefix.
